## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2019-06-30: DEFM14A filed with form-of TRA as Annex F to the merger agreement
- 2019-10-15: Amendment No. 1 to merger agreement replaces the form-of TRA; substantive terms unchanged
- 2019-11-08: Business combination closes; DFB Healthcare renamed AdaptHealth Corp.; TRA executed (8-K Exhibit 10.2)

#### Payment phase

- 2024-12-31: First material payment year ($1.4M in 2024 after $3.2M in 2023)
- 2025-Q1: $25.0M scheduled payment, reflecting maturation of tax benefits from accumulated exchanges
- 2026-Q1: Additional $26.8M payment

## Explanation

AdaptHealth's TRA was executed on November 8, 2019 as part of the SPAC business combination that converted DFB Healthcare Acquisitions Corp. into AdaptHealth Corp., the public parent of a Up-C structure with AdaptHealth Holdings LLC as the operating partnership. AdaptHealth pays 85% of the cash tax savings it realizes from (i) the A Blocker's pre-combination tax attributes, (ii) basis step-ups generated when Non-Blocker Members exchange Company Common Units (plus Class B shares) for Class A common stock, and (iii) imputed interest and basis-on-payment top-ups, with a ten-year sunset after the final exchange. No amendments, restatements, or terminations have been filed; cash payments began at modest levels in 2023 ($3.2M) and stepped up materially in 2025 ($25.0M in Q1 alone) and 2026 ($26.8M in Q1) as accumulated basis step-ups generated realized tax savings. The contract continues in force as of the Q1 2026 10-Q. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
